manuscript_summary: The integrated evidence snapshot passes 95 native tests, including all six opt-in chain tests, and 20 selected process scenarios covering authenticated transport, bilateral isolation, earned-child recovery, refund resolution and custody. The final source differs only by removal of a redundant dereference, checked by strict Clippy, four affected unit tests and a fresh authenticated payout/refund run. All roles remain under author control. Broader formal-source mapping, file-hygiene, hosted and deployment qualification remain open.
